summary: Spec-fidelity audit complete. 31 records: 20 findings/risks + 3 recommendations + 8 grounded negatives. Hard defects: M17 over-cap bounce and setup-ceremony match_start have no data source (engine records neither attempted draws nor emits match_start online; only new events are fine/trade); trade settlement as 'two engine gift steps, engine unchanged' is not atomic (engine silently drops unreceivable items; order-dependent partial transfers even when post-swap caps clear); server phase clocks vs client cascade replay lets bot/reload animations consume the human's 60s/30s windows. Audit-closure misses: L4, G2, I2, E4-edge unaddressed. Guide misses: per-type cap (3/type) absent from the KIT readout, no-hard-max player count silently frozen at 5, M14 chip-dissolve ambiguity can violate guide:69 (Handcuffs must stay). Internal: cylinder dial double-cast as seat pointer and shell container vs #3b=A; dual trade mechanisms (indexed engine Trade vs offer flow) unreconciled; bot 'gift' events have no moment. Clean sweeps recorded as grounded negatives: phase legality, visibility, moment completeness, engine-fix citations, gen-counter scheme, economy/trade/timeout fidelity. 3 gaps (v1 port claims, dice synthesis, out-of-facet client perf).
